title: Peter DuBois Named CIO
summary: FBIN’s Board of Directors has named Peter DuBois EVP & CIO, effective November 2, 2026
body_markdown:
Fortune Brands Innovations has named Peter DuBois Executive Vice President & Chief Information Officer, effective November 2, 2026.


“Peter is a practical, business-minded technology leader who has consistently focused on connecting technology investments to measurable outcomes for customers and the business. We are pleased to welcome him to the team,” said Jesse Singh, CEO.


For more information, view Fortune Brands’[October 27th announcement](https://ir.fbin.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fortune-brands-innovations-strengthens-leadership-drive-focus) .
